owner_reality: 画像品質は上がったが全体デザインは酷い
primary_diagnosis: The benchmark research and module registry exist, but the Production path lacks a research-derived visual variant bridge. Rich planning semantics are compressed into generic labels and then rendered through a shared page skeleton, allowing internal architecture/QA to PASS while visible whole-page design remains generic.
causal_chain: Issue #44 extracts benchmark mechanisms and assigns pattern_ids.
Later architecture freezes Family and creates semantic CompositionPlan fields.
authored_composition_contract compresses persuasion into small enums such as hero/core/trust/closing plus scene intents.
premium_authorship adds global decision-job copy dictionaries, generic hero labels, four visual voice modes and a small dramaturgy vocabulary.

render_premium_asset_bound_html serializes all pages through one shared DOM/CSS grammar with repeated header, hero, offer grid, indexed scenes, proof cards, CTA pills, dark closing panel and shared responsive collapse.
QA verifies safety, provenance, responsive cleanliness, plan preservation and some divergence, but does not require visual fidelity to selected benchmark mechanisms.
Aoi can therefore PASS defect absence and local authored differences without proving whole-page art-direction quality.
Shun's owner-level review correctly reveals the missing whole-page premium design gate.

root_causes.name: Missing Research Pattern → Production Variant bridge
root_causes.evidence: Issue #44 pattern_ids exist, but production code does not select or consume those pattern_ids as real visual variants.
root_causes.effect: Research cannot materially control final visual design.
root_causes.correction: Introduce a Production-ready Premium Module Variant Library with direct source_pattern_ids and renderer implementation identities.

root_causes.name: Semantic compression destroys benchmark mechanism fidelity
root_causes.evidence: CompositionPlan reduces broad mechanisms to hero/core/trust/closing and generic scene intents.
root_causes.effect: Different researched mechanisms can converge to the same runtime semantic token.
root_causes.correction: Keep semantic plan, but add a post-Family research-derived variant selection layer before rendering.

root_causes.name: Shared renderer skeleton dominates page silhouette
root_causes.evidence: render_premium_asset_bound_html uses one premium-shell/header/hero/offer-grid/premium-scene/proof-card/CTA/dark-closing DOM and CSS grammar.
root_causes.effect: Topology differences are visually weaker than the shared skeleton.
root_causes.correction: Renderer must dispatch to variant-owned scene implementations and a page-level art-direction spine rather than one generic scene template.

root_causes.name: Global visual voice enum is too coarse
root_causes.evidence: derive_visual_voice selects only calm/structured/forward/editorial and then changes limited type/measure/rule/image/accent tokens.
root_causes.effect: Art direction becomes a skin over the same composition.
root_causes.correction: Move typography, spatial rhythm, media geometry and material language into each Production Variant plus coherent page-level rules.

root_causes.name: Public copy is decision-job templating, not company-specific editorial authorship
root_causes.evidence: HERO_HEADLINES, SCENE_HEADLINES and SCENE_SUPPORT are global dictionaries reused across companies.
root_causes.effect: Pages can differ structurally while still speaking with one system voice.
root_causes.correction: Variant selection must expose copy-density/role constraints; public copy must be generated from Company Truth + Decision Signature + selected mechanism, then evidence checked.

root_causes.name: Media binding improved asset quality without changing composition authority
root_causes.evidence: Visual Asset Library binds rights-safe assets, but common aspect ratios and scene containers still control image behavior.
root_causes.effect: Better images sit inside mediocre shared layouts.
root_causes.correction: Variant owns crop, aspect, layering, edge behavior, caption/proof relationship and sequence role.

root_causes.name: Mobile is responsive collapse, not mechanism-specific re-art-direction
root_causes.evidence: mobile behavior mostly changes media order, text measure and vertical stacking of the same DOM.
root_causes.effect: Desktop template smell persists on mobile.
root_causes.correction: Every Production Variant requires explicit mobile transform and screenshot acceptance evidence.

root_causes.name: Motion is generic decoration rather than mechanism
root_causes.evidence: shared premium-reveal applies to hero and scenes irrespective of research pattern.
root_causes.effect: Motion adds polish but not authored differentiation.
root_causes.correction: Motion belongs to the variant only when it clarifies sequence, hierarchy, comparison or process.

root_causes.name: QA optimized for defect absence and contract preservation
root_causes.evidence: Issue #111/#116 PASS established responsive/safety/provenance/plan locks and local visual checks, but no benchmark-pattern-to-screenshot fidelity gate existed.
root_causes.effect: A page can be valid, safe and technically differentiated while still looking poor.
root_causes.correction: Aoi whole-page gate must compare actual screenshots to selected research mechanisms and can RETURN on overall design failure even when all technical QA is green.

root_causes.name: Issue #114 underestimated the architecture layer that needed replacement
root_causes.evidence: #114 correctly identified shared CSS/template smell but recommended minimal uplift rather than a real research-to-visual-variant bridge.
root_causes.effect: #116 improved symptoms while preserving the compression architecture.
root_causes.correction: Withdraw the 'minimal uplift is sufficient' assumption; preserve upstream contracts but redesign the visible variant/rendering bridge.

root_causes.name: No per-variant screenshot acceptance artifact
root_causes.evidence: Current traces prove plan/media/QA status but do not prove a named benchmark mechanism is visually recognizable in the screenshot.
root_causes.effect: VISUALLY_VERIFIED can be claimed too loosely.
root_causes.correction: Variant acceptance requires benchmark mechanism notes + desktop/mobile reference expectations + generated screenshot review status.

what_is_not_the_root_cause: a need to restart broad benchmark research from zero
recovery_principle: Preserve truth/Family/evidence/rights/CompositionPlan locks; replace the visual bridge that currently compresses research into generic tokens and one shared renderer grammar.
